reviews.text:
I called around several handymen today to get an estimate on fixing my cracked doorframe and replacing the lock plate. Most of the contractors didn’t get back to me. Another company quoted me $1700 for the job while Jacob offered me two options: one that was $350 for a frame and molding replacement and the other that was $200 for nailing the misaligned lock plate into the frame and adding wood pieces and caulking to secure it.

He came to work on the job a few hours after  my call and confirming. He was very communicative and patient as I was understanding the options he provided. As he worked he took the time to explain to me what he was doing would be better for the longterm since the foundation shifts and the door may need to be realigned.

I am already thinking of other projects I would love to have Jacob help with and highly recommend his services.
reviews.author: Learning with Lani

reviews.text: Great experience ! I had lots of water damage due to a drain leak under my kitchen sink. Everything needed to be rebuilt and replaced including all the drywall on the other side of the sink. Because of the location of the leek it went unnoticed for a few years jugging by the amount of damage. Jacob and Kevin showed up, put together a plain and got started. They were very professional and took pride in the quality of their work. I could not be happier with the outcome and the price was reasonable as well. I am attaching some before and after pic's
reviews.author: Dave Smith

reviews.text: Jacob did an amazing job at such short notice. He was able to correct a previous contractors mistake, and I'm so happy with the results. Just in time for Christmas!
reviews.author: S L

reviews.text: I am very pleased with the job that Jacob did repairing the drywall around my new laundry room water supply faucets, which the plumber had to cut out installing the faucets. Jacob also re-plastered and repainted the new drywall. I honestly cannot tell that the wall was ever damaged. The job Jacob did was of the highest quality, and at a very reasonable price. I will definitely recommend Touchstone Handyman to my friends, and hire them again for other projects.
reviews.author: ellisintl

reviews.text: I contacted Touchstone Handyman for some work around my house. Jacob was quick in getting back to me and answered all my queries. He showed up on time and is friendly to work with. He was able to get everything I needed done quickly and efficiently. All of my tasks have been completed in timely manner. Jacob was great!  I would definitely recommend this company.
reviews.author: D V

reviews.text: Needed new attic ladder installed and Touchstone came out next day and installed, painted, and applied new trim. New attic ladder looks and functions great, extremely happy with outcome. Will use Touchstone Handyman services in the future, highly recommend for any job.
reviews.author: Evan L

reviews.text: Jacob did an amazing job with multiple tasks around our house. He showed up early every day and worked diligently. His personality is a joy and he is a pleasure to talk to. He explained everything he was doing in great detail and answered any questions we had. He did drywall, cabinetry, and replaced an attic ladder as well as laid down plywood throughout the attic. His quote was significantly cheaper than other contractors. I would 10/10 recommend Touchstone Handyman services!
reviews.author: Avi Saund

reviews.text: Found Touchstone Handyman services by searching online for help to replace my attic ladder. They responded within minutes. Extremely easy to work with, and did an incredible job on the install. Good attitude. Great work. Left everything spotless too. Highly recommended and I'll use again.
reviews.author: Justin Rives

reviews.text: Had an issue with a toilet and Joshua saved the day. Used this company about a year ago and was glad I still had the magnet on my refrigerator. New owner, same great service. The only difference is now you'll get a quicker response reaching out online whereas before it was quicker to call but hey, it is 2025.
reviews.author: Mike Collins

reviews.text: Fast response and clearly communicated. Able to get a quick response and Jacob did the job efficiently. Will be happy to rebook for future projects! Also can’t be the price!
reviews.author: Sierra Holloway

reviews.text: Jacob did a fantastic job installing my TV. He was professional, punctual, and took great care to ensure a clean and secure installation. I’m very happy with the results!
reviews.author: Anis Dhakal

reviews.text: Jacob replaced and painted new siding for us. He did an EXCELLENT job. We had other contractors give us bids but they were outrageous. Jacob gave us a very reasonable price AND his work was superior. We will definitely be hiring him for future projects.
reviews.author: Margaret Linsteadt

reviews.text: Jacob is a wonderful person to have as a handyman!! He helped installed a window unit and repaired a fence post for me. He is very transparent with the job activity and costs, gives you options, and delivers quality work! Super affordable and is my go to handyman for future home projects. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Alejandro Gonzalez

reviews.text: Touchstone handyman repaired and painted my chimney.  Jacob was professional, personable, and very knowledgeable. He calls to let you know when he’s on the way and throughout the job to give updates.  Highly recommended and will consider this company for future projects.
reviews.author: Dana Sabetta

reviews.text: Jacob at Touchstone did an excellent job fixing up my rental property. He did a thorough inspection of the house and made all necessary repairs. He got the job done quickly and was upfront about all expected costs. I would definitely use again!
reviews.author: Jacob Bartlow

reviews.text: I used Touchstone Handyman to remove and replace some steps between my garage and door to the house. Jacob did a great job. Completed work in a timely manner and at the quoted price. No surprises just quality work at a fair price. In a time when it can be difficult to find a handyman who is reliable and does good work. Touchstone Handyman does the job. I would definitely hire them again.
reviews.author: Leon Kerkman

reviews.text: Jacob was awesome!!! He came over to do a chimney sweep for me but after looking told me I didn’t need one and that he wouldn’t feel right charging me for a full sweep. He then took time to walk around my house to see if there were other repairs needed and gave me estimates with detailed explanations. He also pointed out the things in my house that were done well, which I appreciated as I typically only see the bad. I look forward to working with him to get all the projects completed around my house!
reviews.author: Melissa Morris

reviews.text: Jacob has been wonderful! He is always prompt at getting back to me, the prices are very reasonable and he does a great job! I have used Touchstone twice and will continue to use them in the future. I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Amy Vick

reviews.text: We had Jacob from Touchstone come repair our chimney and replace our back door. He was on time and got the work done quickly. He explained what needed to be done and did it. We will be using Touchstone again in the future for our home repairs.
reviews.author: Angie Peterson

reviews.text: Jacob is the owner and also the technician that came. I contacted him after hours and got a email that he would contact next business day. He did and we made arrangements for the work. From my initial contact until job was completed, Jacob kept in contact with me. COMMUNICATION. Arrived on time, completed job quickly and correct. Reasonable price. I do recommend.
reviews.author: Jeff Rhoads

reviews.text: Jacob at Touchstone Handyman replaced my mail box post and mailbox. He did such a nice job, more than what I expected. He's very knowledgeable, efficient and licensed!  And such a nice person!  Highly recommend Touchstone Handyman!
reviews.author: Jan Shaw

reviews.text:
By far the best handyman company in Fort Worth. Reliable, trustworthy, professional work, and great price.
I will definitely recommend Jacob with Touchstone Handyman to anyone who’s looking to get some repairs done around their house.
Thanks again, Jacob!

Looking forward to working with you again in our next home improvement project, which is our garage.

reviews.text:
Dryer Vent cleaning!

Based our previous experience, we are having our dryer vent cleaned every two years.   Jacob arrived on time and did a thorough job from setup to cleanup.    He even showed us how much had been cleaned out over the last two years!   We were most appreciative and relieved that we will be safe for the next two years.  We would definitely use Jacob again and for any of his services.
reviews.author: Thomas Duffy

reviews.text: Very detailed work I was impressed ! Jacob repaired and repainted my quest bathroom shower area after a/c leaked and half the ceiling needed replaced.  It took 3 days in and out several times a day ( I think I was squeezed in) and $1600 later I was good as new.

reviews.text: We had several door's in need of repair especially the locks, called Jacob on a Thursday and he was here at 9 am the next day just as he said he would be, was professional and courteous also cleaned up after his work was done. we will feel much safer knowing that our door's are secured. If you are in need of any home repairs I strongly recommend you to call Jacob, I will continue to rely on him for any future repairs for our home. Thank You Jacob and may God Bless, Vickie and Dennis

reviews.text: Very professional and easy to communicate with. Price felt fair and the quality of the work was exceptional. I will most certainly be using touchstone again for all of my drywall repair and handyman needs in the fort worth, TX area in the future!

reviews.text: Jacob was super friendly! He left my fireplace and surrounding area spotless after servicing. Will be a returning customer next time I need services done. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.text: Touchstone Handyman is respectable small business. I hired Jacob to tackle some minor repairs in my home and his prices were reasonable and he was very responsive. Highly recommended businessman.

reviews.text: I found Touchstone Handyman through Groupon for a dryer vent cleaning.  When I called, Jacob was available very quickly and we made an appointment.  He arrived on time, had the specific equipment he needed, got right to work and got the job done. He showed me amount of lint and dirt he got out of the dryer vent and I was amazed.  He cleaned up after himself and gave us recommendations on how to keep the vent cleaner in the future and when to call him back for another deep cleaning. He was professional, efficient, thorough and very likable. We are now in discussions about how he can do some other Handyman things around our house. I highly recommend him and will certainly use him again.
reviews.author: Rickie Springer

reviews.text:
I needed a privacy fence built quickly. I called Touchstone and they (Jacob) came in quickly and knocked out the job. I had a bit of experience, just not enough hours in the day, but I was able to jump in and help out. Things moved right along and two days later we had a 700'+ long, redwood privacy fence. Just in time for our hog roast.  Ended up inventing him to our roast!

Jacob was diligent, professional and worked with the heart of a teacher.
reviews.author: Brad Sadek

reviews.text: Jacob repaired door frame from garage to laundry room, installed smoke detectors and installed two storm doors. Very knowledgeable, young man, and very professional. I’ve used him at my business as well.. Highly recommend Touchstone Handyman and Jacob

reviews.text: Jacob did some top notch work on my broken picket fence. Was very thorough in explaining exactly what work needed to be done and what the cost would be. Reasonable rates and excellent communication. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.text: They replaced our old, dangerous attic folding ladder with a new sturdy , and easier to use, aluminum ladder. We also added plywood flooring in our attic. Entire job went smoothly, and on time. I have already consulted Jacob for some additional work.

reviews.text: I called one time. Left contact info, project description and never heard back. Contacted them a few times in hopes of not getting voicemail, only got voicemail. Now, months later, after I've moved to another city, I'm getting constant spam from them asking for a review! Unbelievable. I got texts first asking, then demanding I review them. I blocked that number. NOW I'm getting email spam from them wanting a review. So, before I report them as spam and block their email address, I thought I would do what they're demanding and post a review. This is it. I never had anyone call, email, or even send a letter the MONTHS I reached out to them trying to find out if they worked in my neighborhood, was interested. Nothing. Now, spam and more spam. Call someone else. Do not give them your info.
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.text: I had them out to clean my gutters when it was raining, they did a good job. My gutter were overflowing and leaking water all over the place. Touchstone was out quickly and unclogged my gutters and that was that. I would recommend.

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The 5-star reviews contain highly specific details about projects, costs, and personnel. The few negative reviews point to a specific, credible operational weakness (initial responsiveness/lead follow-up) and an aggressive review solicitation tactic, but do not dispute the quality of work for actual customers. The volume and consistency over time suggest a legitimate, quality-focused business.
authentic_signals: Specific project details (doorframe, water damage, attic ladder)
Varied writing styles and reviewer profiles
Mention of crew names (Jacob, Kevin, Joshua)
Mix of praise and minor constructive feedback in owner responses
Logical timeline of reviews over 4 years
